# Aunt Drusilla

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P26](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0026), [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)</sub>
- **Family:** [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Aunt Drusilla wears a washed-out old wrapper. Her hair is gray and unmistakably messy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021)_

## Personality

Aunt Drusilla is known for her remarkably sharp tongue and sarcastic demeanor. She speaks so bitingly that it is rumored she would deliver sarcastic remarks to mourners even from beyond the grave.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P20](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0020), [v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)_

## Traits

- presumed sarcastic  <sub>[v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)</sub>
- sharp-tongued  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P20](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0020)</sub>

_Not yet known._

## Goals

## History

Aunt Drusilla was left in poverty and solitude following the death of her husband, after which she was welcomed into the Duckett household. Prior to this, she caused a disruption at a prayer meeting in [Tullyvale](../codex/places.md#tullyvale) by delivering a harsh tongue-lashing to the congregation. She later hosted [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde when they dropped off jelly at her home, subjecting them to unpleasant remarks.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018), [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042)_

## Quotes

> "Well, talking to an old woman such as myself probably doesn't offer you much entertainment, I reckon. It is a shame that the boys are not at home."
>
> — Aunt Drusilla — [v3 ch.Life P32](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0032)

> "Mrs. Pullen mentioned to me that you were back. She noted that you had gotten much better."
>
> — Aunt Drusilla — [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)

> "Your mother’s jelly has never appealed to me, as her recipe is always overly sweet. All the same, I shall attempt to force a little of it down. This spring, my eating has been terribly poor. My health is quite poor"
>
> — Aunt Drusilla — [v3 ch.Life P26](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0026)

> "Word has reached me that your wedding will take place in June, Isolde."
>
> — Aunt Drusilla — [v3 ch.Life P36](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0036)

> "I’ve heard of you."
>
> — Aunt Drusilla — [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)
